# pull

Pull web resources to a local folder with tracking metadata

## Usage

```
ppds webresources pull [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `folder` | yes | Target directory (created if missing) |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--force` |  | `bool` |  | Overwrite local files even when they have been edited since the last pull |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Filter by partial name match |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Filter by solution unique name |
| `--strip-prefix` |  | `bool` |  | Remove the solution publisher prefix from local file paths (e.g., new_/scripts/app.js -&gt; scripts/app.js). The prefix is org-specific and set by the solution publisher. |
| `--type` | `-t` | `string` |  | Filter by type: text, image, data, or specific type (js, css, html, xml, png, etc.) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
